Retaining the legacy <app-sidemenu> within the new DashboardShellComponent is the optimal architectural approach (DRY / Separation of Concerns), rather than creating a bloated monolith shell component.

Regarding the data: { sideMenu: true } in the routing blocks: QA flagged this as a bug, but upon investigation, this flag is structurally required by app.component.html to render the DashboardShellComponent at all.
